notes: Question #6: expand each employee into one row per active month (do i=0 to N; month_active=intnx('month', anchor, i, 'same'); output; end;) then tally a monthly headcount via a sort + retain(total_employees) + first.month_active reset. hr_transactions14 (the Questions #1-5 output) is stood in with two employees: one hired Jan 2001 and still active (termdate 12/31/2999), one hired Jan 2001 and terminated June 2001, covering both the current=1 and current=0 branches. The DO-loop bound was reduced from 95 (96 months across 2001-2008) to 11 (12 months, 2001 only) to keep the bundle's output small; the loop mechanics, INTNX usage, and the tally/collapse logic are otherwise unmodified from the source.
